proposed_rows.role: recursive base first-order language
proposed_rows.notes: Recursive syntax and finite arities; no computable model diagram is assumed.

proposed_rows.role: recursive same-sort expansion language
proposed_rows.notes: May have countably many new symbols; finite-sentence variants are separately named.

proposed_rows.role: fixed underlying model and domain
proposed_rows.notes: Actual witnesses must be selected from this model; an elementary extension is not the desired fixed-domain expansion.

proposed_rows.role: expansion on exactly the original domain
proposed_rows.notes: Old symbols and the designated finite parameter tuple are unchanged.

proposed_rows.role: finite named parameter tuple
proposed_rows.notes: External finite syntactic names do not make the domain computably numbered.

proposed_rows.role: recursive or computably enumerable finite-block type
proposed_rows.notes: Not necessarily complete; coding before parameter interpretation is explicit.

proposed_rows.role: canonical tautological padding tag
proposed_rows.notes: Syntactic length encodes a finite enumeration stage; the tag is not simplified.

proposed_rows.role: full elementary diagram of the fixed model
proposed_rows.notes: Not assumed recursive or c.e.; it is not included in the proof enumeration for the projection type.

proposed_rows.role: stage expansion requirement theory
proposed_rows.notes: C.e. axioms and finite parameter footprint at each stage; the axiom set need not be finite.

proposed_rows.role: equality pattern relative to old parameters
proposed_rows.notes: Separates coordinates fixed to old parameters from fresh distinct coordinate classes.

proposed_rows.role: base-language consequence type
proposed_rows.notes: C.e. consequences of effective expansion requirements; no complete-type or diagram decision oracle.

proposed_rows.role: recursive comparison type
proposed_rows.notes: Separate proof-local q role; implications compare actual parameter tuples rather than enumerating their true type.

proposed_rows.role: elementary base embedding used for transport
proposed_rows.notes: The named image is proved an elementary expanded substructure before transporting the new interpretations.

proposed_rows.role: given relation whose definability is tested
proposed_rows.notes: Recursive saturation of the given expansion (M,R) is an explicit extra hypothesis.

proposed_rows.role: finite signed base-formula cell
proposed_rows.notes: The finite union of membership-positive cells is the actual defining formula.

proposed_rows.role: structure tested for atomic compactness
proposed_rows.notes: No recursive-language requirement in this scope.

proposed_rows.role: arbitrary set of unknown variables
proposed_rows.notes: Not necessarily finite or countable; each individual formula is finite.

proposed_rows.role: system of formulas with arbitrary parameters from A
proposed_rows.notes: Atomic and positive systems have distinct formula classes but the same full parameter/unknown scope.

proposed_rows.role: retraction homomorphism fixing A
proposed_rows.notes: Onto but not asserted injective or elementary; universal-positive preservation uses surjectivity.

proposed_rows.role: unknown indexed by an extension element
proposed_rows.notes: Every function/relation constraint and every x_a=a fixed-parameter clause is included.

proposed_rows.role: nonempty reduced-power index set
proposed_rows.notes: In the converse I is the set of all finite subsystems including the empty one.

proposed_rows.role: proper filter of index subsets
proposed_rows.notes: No full first-order Los statement is claimed for a general proper filter.

proposed_rows.role: equality on a filter-large set
proposed_rows.notes: Defines quotient identity and representative independence.

proposed_rows.role: cone of finite subsystems extending v
proposed_rows.notes: Finite intersections are cones for finite unions and are nonempty.

proposed_rows.role: coordinate function assembled from finite-system solutions
proposed_rows.notes: Selected actual assignments supply a simultaneous quotient solution before retraction.

proposed_rows.role: constant naming the standard number k
proposed_rows.notes: All names form a recursive language; the omitted type has no extra parameters.

proposed_rows.role: Delhomme-native logical identity atom on same-sort terms
proposed_rows.scope: P3 Delhomme atomic presentation and homomorphism diagram
proposed_rows.notes: Binding selectors: def:p03-resplendence-atomic t_1 equiv t_2; thm:p03-resplendence-positive-maps left satisfaction atom; annex:p03-resplendence-positive-maps native-atom proof; annex:p03-resplendence-atomic-retractions x_a equiv a and function-value identity atoms; annex:p03-resplendence-topological native diagonal constraint; annex:p03-resplendence-atomic-powers native quotient-atom clause. Both syntactic operands are L(A)-terms; interpreted operands are objects in one sort. Not elementary equivalence of structures.

proposed_rows.role: host logical identity atom used only in the satisfaction comparison
proposed_rows.notes: Binding selectors: rightmost C,s models (t_1=t_2) in the theorem's bridge and its exact proof at annex:p03-resplendence-positive-maps. Both operands are same-sort terms. This bridge does not rewrite the source presentation or its homomorphism diagram.

proposed_rows.role: metamathematical identity of interpreted object values
proposed_rows.notes: Binding selector: middle t_1^C(s)=t_2^C(s) clause of the bridge. Operands are interpreted objects not formulas or structures. Ordinary equals elsewhere remains unchanged.

proposed_rows.role: syntactic term operand of a logical identity atom
proposed_rows.scope: P3 Delhomme atomic definition and satisfaction bridge
proposed_rows.notes: L(A)-terms j=1 or 2; all variables and named parameters receive their existing interpretations.

proposed_rows.role: object value of a term under assignment s
proposed_rows.notes: The bridge proof evaluates variables parameters and function terms recursively before comparing the two values.

proposed_rows.role: structure interpreting the satisfaction bridge and typed contrast
proposed_rows.scope: P3 atomic-definition contrast and satisfaction bridge
proposed_rows.notes: Binding selectors: structure C in C equiv D contrast and C,s models displays; not a Boolean coefficient algebra or an object term.

proposed_rows.role: structure operand of elementary-equivalence contrast
proposed_rows.notes: Binding selector: D in C equiv D only. The full elementary diagram D in the earlier Henkin proofs retains its separate declared role.
